stamps.name: ABN Approved
stamps.rule: An official award from an authorized ABN account. Personal approval cannot be earned automatically.

stamps.name: The Truth
stamps.rule: Listen for 60 qualifying seconds. Production checks server-issued playback sessions and bounded progress receipts.
stamps.previewRule: Listen to 60 seconds of the preview record while this page is visible.

stamps.name: Guerilla Maab
stamps.rule: A verified award by an authorized Guerilla Maab affiliate or staff campaign. Membership does not buy approval.

stamps.name: Street Certified
stamps.rule: Explore four different Houston landmarks for at least five qualifying seconds each.
stamps.previewRule: Explore four different Houston landmark viewpoints.

stamps.name: Crate Digger
stamps.rule: Open five different releases for at least eight qualifying seconds each.
stamps.previewRule: Open five different releases from the record shelves or archive.

stamps.name: Chopped In
stamps.rule: Make four manual crossfader cuts during authorized DJ playback. Automatic chops do not qualify.
stamps.previewRule: Play the record and make four manual cuts with the DJ crossfader.

stamps.name: Project Collector
stamps.rule: Collect a project-specific stamp when an eligible project download is authorized and delivery starts. Each eligible project has its own permanent stamp.
